title: Business Administration, Tri-Cities Campus Only
sourceText:
B A 100

ECONS 101 [SSCI] or 102 [SSCI]

ENGLISH 101 [WRTG] or 105 [WRTG]

MATH 201
MATH 201 will be waived with an Aleks score of 80% or higher or the completion of MATH 202 or equivalent. MATH 106 will be accepted as an alternative to MATH 201 for transfer students.

UCORE Inquiry and Complementary Fields of Study
Must complete 5 of these 6 UCORE designations: ARTS, BSCI, DIVR, EQJS, HUM, PSCI. One lab science (BSCI or PSCI) must be completed.
Complementary Fields of Study (12 credits): Any courses with the [SSCI], or [HUM] designation (excluding courses in ACCTG, B A, B LAW, ENTRP, FIN, HBM, I BUS, MGMT, MGTOP, MIS, and MKTG), or courses in ANTH, AIS, ART, ASIA, ASTRONOM, BIOLOGY, CES, CHEM, CHINESE, COM, COMJOUR, COMSTRAT, CRM J, DTC, ECONS (excluding 101, 102, 198, and 327), ENGLISH (excluding 101, 105, 402, and 403), ENTOM, FOR LANG, FRENCH, FS, GERMAN, HISTORY (excluding 105 and 305), HONORS 270, 280, 370, 380, H D (excluding 205), HORT, HUMANITY, I D, ITALIAN, JAPANESE, KINES, LATIN, LND ARCH, MATH, MBIOS, MIL SCI, MUS, NEP, NEUROSCI, PHIL, PHYSICS, PL P, POL S, PSYCH, PUBHLTH, SHS, SOC, SOE, SOIL SCI, SPANISH, WGSS, and WRITE.

ECONS 101 or 102

HBM 101 and B A 102, or HBM 105

HISTORY 105 [ROOT]

MATH 202 [QUAN]
Alternative to MATH 202 is MATH 140 or 171.

UCORE Inquiry
Must complete 5 of these 6 UCORE designations: ARTS, BSCI, DIVR, EQJS, HUM, PSCI. One lab science (BSCI or PSCI) must be completed.

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 1

Apply for Admission into the Major

ACCTG 230

B A 201, 202, and 203, or B A 211

Complementary Fields of Study
Complementary Fields of Study (12 credits): Any courses with the [SSCI], or [HUM] designation (excluding courses in ACCTG, B A, B LAW, ENTRP, FIN, HBM, I BUS, MGMT, MGTOP, MIS, and MKTG), or courses in ANTH, AIS, ART, ASIA, ASTRONOM, BIOLOGY, CES, CHEM, CHINESE, COM, COMJOUR, COMSTRAT, CRM J, DTC, ECONS (excluding 101, 102, 198, and 327), ENGLISH (excluding 101, 105, 402, and 403), ENTOM, FOR LANG, FRENCH, FS, GERMAN, HISTORY (excluding 105 and 305), HONORS 270, 280, 370, 380, H D (excluding 205), HORT, HUMANITY, I D, ITALIAN, JAPANESE, KINES, LATIN, LND ARCH, MATH, MBIOS, MIL SCI, MUS, NEP, NEUROSCI, PHIL, PHYSICS, PL P, POL S, PSYCH, PUBHLTH, SHS, SOC, SOE, SOIL SCI, SPANISH, WGSS, and WRITE.

MIS 250

Consider studying abroad this summer
All students must complete the International Experience Requirement. Options for completing the requirement can be found in the Carson College of Business Academic Unit section of the catalog under Business. Students should consult with their advisor to determine the best option.

ACCTG 231

B A 204, 205, and 206, or B A 212

B LAW 210

COM 102 [COMM], H D 205 [COMM], or MKTG 279 [COMM]

MGTOP 215
STAT 212 will be accepted as alternative to MGTOP 215 for transfer students.

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 2

Complete Writing Portfolio

ENGLISH 402 or 403

I BUS 380

MKTG 360

300- or 400-level Business or ECONS Elective
300- or 400-level Business or ECONS elective (11 credits).  Must include at least 6 credits of 400-level business courses. May not include courses from the CCB core, the set of required business administration courses, or 499 Special Topics courses, or any 498 internship, except that up to three credits of B A 498 may be included as a 400-level business elective.

ACCTG 338

FIN 325

MGMT 401

MGTOP 340

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 3

FIN 425 [M]

400-level Business Electives
300- or 400-level Business or ECONS elective (11 credits).  Must include at least 6 credits of 400-level business courses. May not include courses from the CCB core, the set of required business administration courses, or 499 Special Topics courses, or any 498 internship, except that up to three credits of B A 498 may be included as a 400-level business elective.

International Experience Requirement or Electives
All students must complete the International Experience Requirement. Options for completing the requirement can be found in the Carson College of Business Academic Unit section of the catalog under Business. Students should consult with their advisor to determine the best option.

MGMT 491 [CAPS] or ENTRP 492 [CAPS]

MKTG 368 [M]

Complete Carson Career Amplifier Program Tier 4

The following major is available only to students on the Tri-Cities campus.  The Everett, Global, Pullman, and Vancouver campuses do not offer this major. 

Graduation Requirements

To graduate with a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration with a major in Business Administration, students are required to complete all admission and graduation requirements listed in the Carson College of Business (CCB) section of the catalog and the coursework included in the sample 4-year plan listed below.
